-- Buscar na subscription_charges pelo nome do cliente Ryan Gustavo
SELECT sc.id, sc.asaas_payment_id, sc.value, sc.due_date, sc.status, s.client_id, ac.name as clientName
FROM subscription_charges sc
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id
WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Ryan%'
ORDER BY sc.due_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
